primary.title: International Youth Day: Fewer responsibilities, longer time — how Gen Z can harness their 20s for wealth creation
primary.summary: Your 20s can offer a powerful financial advantage: time, fewer responsibilities and the opportunity to build disciplined investing habits early. Experts explain how Gen Z can use SIPs, manage debt, control lifestyle inflation and avoid common investing mistakes to build long-term wealth.
